alignment_definition: paired raw[i] with out[i + alignment_offset]; offsets inferred by minimum repeated-ADC mapping conflicts and monotonicity violations within [-8,+8]
alignment_offsets_note: Offsets are data-sequence alignment corrections inferred by testing offsets -8..+8 and selecting the zero-conflict, zero-monotonicity-violation alignment. They are not hardware-clock or YM2413 subclock offsets.
